scope_note: L'Hebdo des socialistes n°867, dated 17 to 30 June 2017 on its first page. Imported: the report of Jean-Christophe Cambadélis's decision to hand over to a collective direction (PDF p. 1) and the Bureau national of Tuesday 20 June 2017 (PDF p. 2). The issue prints no day for the decision. An issue of the Parti socialiste's weekly, a party record for its own offices, as digitized and served by the Fondation Jean-Jaurès's Centre d'archives socialistes (the party's foundation archive). rows.text: The issue reports that 'Jean-Christophe Cambadélis a décidé de céder sa place de Premier secrétaire à une direction collective', which 'va se mettre en place dans les plus brefs délais'; it prints no day for the decision.

locator.item: front page report, paragraph after the quoted statement

rows.text: The issue reports that the bureau national, 'qui s'est réuni mardi 20 juin', referred to a Conseil national on 8 July 'la composition de la direction collégiale qui doit prendre le relais de Jean-Christophe Cambadélis'.
